Name: Leif - New Gotoran NPC
Author: AutumnDusk01
Description:
[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]

Should be compatible with most location and custom NPCs, including SVE.

[b]FEATURES[/b]

-New location
-Heart events, including post-marriage
-New cooking and crafting recipes
-Spouse room and patio
-Gender neutral seasonal dialogue
-When dating/married to Leif, the relationship pronouns in the social tab will be switched to "partner" and "spouse"

[b]INFO[/b]

[spoiler]Name: Leif
Pronouns: They/Them
Birthday: Winter 24th
Home: Their house in the cindersap forest

[i]Gift tastes[/i]

Loved: Peaches, pancakes, seafoam pudding, rainbow shell, large milk, dragon tooth
Liked: Aquamarine, Rhubarb pie, spaghetti, rice pudding, blueberry tart, melon, blueberry, holly, honey, jelly, strawberry, crystal fruit, truffle oil, fairy rose, ginger, mango, poi, squid ink ravioli
Neutral: Large egg, milk, ice cream, oil, clay, lemon stone, obsidian, shrimp
Disliked: All fish, leek, coconut, red cabbage, pickles, coral, duck feather, aged roe, roe
Hated: Wild horseradish, seaweed, midnight carp, all alcohol, lobster, crayfish, crab

[i]Concession tastes[/i]

Loved: Chocolate popcorn, cotton candy, fries, jawbreaker, nachos, personal pizza, popcorn, rock candy, sour slimes, stardrop sorbet, truffle popcorn
Liked: Black licorice, apple slices, star cookie, kale smoothie, jojacorn, joja soda, jasmine tea, ice cream sandwich, cappuccino mousse cake, salted peanuts
Disliked: Salmon burger, panzanella salad, hummus snack pack

[i]Movie Preferences[/i]

Brave little sapling: Loved
Natural wonders: Liked
Journey of the prairie king: Liked
Wumbus: Disliked
Mysterium: Loved
It howls in the rain: Disliked
A miracle at coldstar ranch: Loved
Zuzu city express: Disliked[/spoiler]
